# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $3539.0, -146.5 (-3.98%) compared with yesterday's close of 3685.5.
Current read: BEARISH. Gold is being pushed DOWN right now. Because it's -3.98% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going down (-0.53%), and today's headlines lean good for gold (4 good vs 1 bad).
Today's range: low $3527.9 to high $3766.8. Price is 5% of the way up that range ($11.1 above the low, $227.8 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: London. Next: US data drop (8:30am ET) in 184 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 10:00 (9.9 pips/min), 09:00 (9.2 pips/min), 11:00 (7.0 pips/min).
Related markets today: US dollar index 103.84 (+0.03%), US 10-year yield 4.912 (-2.77%), Silver 41.07 (-7.41%).
The US dollar is basically flat today, so it is not the thing pushing gold around right now.

Things that do not line up (these are usually the real story):
  - Gold and silver are diverging: silver -7.41% vs gold -3.98%. They normally move together, so this gap is unusual.
  - Bond yields moved -2.77% and gold moved -3.98%. Yields and gold normally move OPPOSITE ways, so this is backwards from the usual relationship.
  - Gold moved -3.98% while the dollar barely moved (+0.03%). So whatever moved gold today was not the dollar.
